test_title: PYST 8: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Puja Tomar, the first Indian woman to achieve a victory in a UFC (Ultimate Fighting Championship) fight in 2024, participates in which sport?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Mixed Martial Arts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)** is a full-contact combat sport that incorporates techniques from various martial arts disciplines.
 
• MMA allows fighters to use **striking, grappling, and ground-fighting techniques** from sports like boxing, wrestling, judo, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, and Muay Thai.
 
• It is regulated by organizations like the **Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC)**, which is the largest MMA organization globally.
 
• MMA has grown immensely in popularity worldwide, including in **India**, where fighters like Puja Tomar have showcased their talent on international platforms.
 
• Puja Tomar’s victory at the UFC marks a significant milestone for **Indian women** in combat sports and demonstrates the growing success of MMA athletes from India.
 
• The sport emphasizes **discipline, physical fitness, and mental toughness**, making it one of the most challenging competitive sports.
 
• The UFC organizes events globally, bringing together fighters from various backgrounds to compete in MMA bouts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Wrestling**__

 __
 
• **Wrestling** is one of the oldest forms of combat sports and involves grappling techniques to pin or take down the opponent.
 
• It is divided into styles like **freestyle wrestling** and **Greco-Roman wrestling**.
 
• Wrestling is a popular Olympic sport and has a rich tradition in **India**, with athletes like **Sushil Kumar** and **Bajrang Punia** achieving international success.
 
 
 
• **Boxing**__
 __
 
• **Boxing** is a combat sport focused on striking techniques using fists.
 
• Boxers wear protective gloves and compete in a ring under strict rules and regulations.
 
• India has produced renowned boxers such as **Mary Kom** and **Vijender Singh**.
 
• Unlike MMA, boxing does not involve grappling or ground-fighting techniques.
 
 
 
• **Judo**__
 
 
• **Judo** is a Japanese martial art and Olympic sport that focuses on grappling techniques.
 
• The goal in judo is to throw the opponent to the ground, immobilize them, or force them to submit using joint locks or chokeholds.
 
• Judo emphasizes **discipline, control, and technique** over brute strength.
 
• India has made its mark in judo with athletes competing in international events like the Olympics and Asian Games.
